cases.question: 分别统计北京大成律所 Alpha 主账号数与 AlphaGPT 产品账号体系账号数（不限定 product_key）
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM alpha_user WHERE alp_office_name LIKE '%北京大成%' AND is_deleted = 0 UNION ALL SELECT COUNT(*) AS account_count FROM alpha_account_user WHERE user_office_name LIKE '%北京大成%' AND is_deleted = 0

cases.question: 统计北京大成本月进线线索数量
cases.goldSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS clue_count FROM alpha_crm_clue WHERE office_name LIKE '%北京大成%' AND clue_create_time >= DATE_FORMAT(CURRENT_DATE(), '%Y-%m-01') AND clue_create_time < DATE_FORMAT(DATE_ADD(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), '%Y-%m-01') AND is_deleted = 0
